trust_decision.summary: The global chi middlewares (Entrance, MustLogin, MustInstall) make their entrance/login/whitelist/ws-ban/app-installed decisions on the raw r.URL.Path. chi.CleanPath and StripSlashes rewrite only rctx.RoutePath, and the router dispatches on that, so a non-canonical path (e.g. a leading double slash) fails the '/api' prefix test and skips login while still routing to an /api handler.

landing_point.why: The advisory reports unauthenticated RCE. The login gate's whitelist and '/api' prefix test is where an engineer would look first.

fix_sites.entry_point: every HTTP route under /api (internal/route/http.go:117, internal/route/ws.go:20) via global middleware chain internal/bootstrap/http.go:21
GET /api/ws/ssh, /api/ws/exec with an API-key Authorization header (internal/route/ws.go:20-23)
any HTTP request (security entrance redirect / API-key entrance rewrite / robots.txt exemption)
global middleware ordering for every request (fix moves StartSession/Compress after CleanPath/StripSlashes)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All published fix sites are in one package, internal/http/middleware, and every site applies one concept: read the path from chi's RoutePath. The fix's only edit to the composition is the middleware reorder at internal/http/middleware/middleware.go:41-56, in the same package.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver who fixes only MustLogin could argue that MustInstall (must_install.go:17-22) is a feature gate rather than an auth check, and that the Entrance robots.txt/redirect comparisons (entrance.go:81,106) are only a cosmetic obscurity layer.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Several behaviours sit next to the sink and must keep working. Non-/api SPA/static paths load without login. The whitelisted login/key/is_login/is_2fa/panel endpoints stay unauthenticated. /robots.txt is exempt from the entrance check. API-key requests under the entrance prefix have their path rewritten to strip the entrance. A blanket fix that rejects every non-canonical path or forces login on all paths breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: raw path that chi.CleanPath normalises differently (duplicate slashes, dot segments) — fix.diff:469-473
trailing slash removed by StripSlashes on RoutePath only — fix.diff:408-409
entrance-prefixed path with Authorization header, rewritten from the cleaned path — fix.diff:376-384
/api/apps/{slug} split for the installed-app gate — fix.diff:446-449

O7_producer.where: The canonical path is produced by chi middleware.CleanPath/StripSlashes, an external dependency (go.mod:11, github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.2.2), registered at internal/http/middleware/middleware.go:44-45. The checks never call it; they read r.URL.Path, which CleanPath does not rewrite (external dependency source not read; see unverified).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The API-key HMAC canonical request signs req.URL.Path (raw) while chi dispatches on the cleaned RoutePath. A per-path token scope, or a path-based deny list checked against the signed path, would reopen the same differential in another package.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The signer sits in internal/data, far from the middleware, and a maintainer would naturally sign the path the client sent. Fixing it needs an understanding of the raw-vs-routed path split (how-type), not just a search.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An additional API-key deny prefix (e.g. a file-download or terminal route) compared against r.URL.Path rather than the routed path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The existing ws ban is an ad-hoc prefix check, so adding a second one is a one-line change a maintainer could plausibly make.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A per-app plugin middleware registered in apploader that gates admin-only app routes by r.URL.Path.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Apps register their own sub-routers under /api/apps, and a plugin author would not know that the global chain switched to RoutePath.

O9_family: authentication bypass via path-normalisation parser differential between the auth middleware (raw r.URL.Path) and the router (cleaned rctx.RoutePath); CWE-305/CWE-436, with CWE-22-style dot/slash segments

services: SQLite/GORM data layer for user tokens and sessions (unverified)
O10_build.project_tests: No *_test.go files under internal/. The middlewares take interfaces (biz.UserTokenRepo, biz.AppRepo; mocks exist at mocks/biz/UserTokenRepo.go), so they can be tested with httptest and a chi.Mux.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Normalise the path, or switch to RoutePath, inside MustLogin only, leaving Entrance and MustInstall on the raw path; or delete CleanPath, which changes routing behaviour.

out_of_scope_notes: internal/http/middleware/entrance.go:81: with entrance == '/', every request without an Authorization header is redirected to /login. This looks odd, but it is not part of this advisory.
internal/route/http.go:426-427: the SPA handler opens r.URL.Path on an embedded FS. This is read-only embed and was not pursued.
